title: Markets we serve: 14 frontier markets on 3 continents | Nazryx
description: Nazryx serves 14 pharmaceutical markets on 3 continents: Central Asia, East and West Africa, North Africa, the Middle East and South America.

sections.title: 14 markets
sections.lede: Asia, Africa and South America. Frontier markets that import most of their medicines, read and run one at a time.

sections.title: What we know
sections.lede: Two facts per market. Kazakhstan is shown in full; every other market file is available on request.

sections.title: Six source countries.
sections.lede: South Asia makes medicines for the world at a price frontier markets can pay. We take them to the markets that need them.

sections.title: Ask for a market file.
sections.text: Tell us which market and send your product list. We will show you what is open there.
